fusions.name: Three on the String
fusions.desc: Looses 3 thin shafts at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Bodkin at Full Draw
fusions.desc: A narrow-headed arrow at a target up to 9 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Slender Shafts
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Held at the Anchor
fusions.desc: When your stamina reaches full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
